title: cellranger_atac_mkfastq
description: Demultiplex raw sequencing data for ATAC experiments

dataset input.title: Dataset input
dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

input.description: Path of Illumina BCL run folder.
input.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `['/path/to/bcl']`

csv.description: The path to the simple layout sample sheet.
csv.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `['SampleSheet.csv']`

lanes.description: bcl2fastq option. Semicolon-delimited series of lanes to demultiplex. Use this if you have a sample sheet for an entire flow cell but only want to generate a few lanes for further 10x Genomics analysis.

use_bases_mask.description: bcl2fastq option. Use to clip extra bases off a read if you ran extra cycles for QC.

delete_undetermined.description: bcl2fastq option. Delete the Undetermined FASTQs generated by bcl2fastq. Useful if you are demultiplexing a small number of samples from a large flow cell.

barcode_mismatches.description: bcl2fastq option. Use this option to change the number of allowed mismatches per index adapter (0, 1, 2).

output.description: The folder to store the demux results
output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, default: `fastqs`, direction: `output`, example: `['/path/to/output']`

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
